screen.acvcape.title: Acv Cape
label.acvcape.custom_empty: No custom capes. Put PNGs in the folder.
label.acvcape.owned_empty: No capes found in your account.
acvcape.field.name: Cape Name (optional)
acvcape.field.name.hint: Leave blank to use the file name...
label.acvcape.favorites_empty: No favorites yet. Right-click a cape to favorite it.
acvcape.import.path.desc: Type the path to the PNG.
acvcape.error.dialog_failed: Could not open the file dialog.
acvcape.prompt.download_single: A player is using a custom cape. Download it?
acvcape.prompt.download_list: %s players are using custom capes. Download them?
label.acvcape.editor_hint: Click the pixels you want to glow. Marked pixels appear brighter.
label.acvcape.editor_no_source: The texture of this cape could not be loaded.
label.acvcape.editor_save_failed: Failed to save the emissive cape.
label.acvcape.inventory_empty: This player has no capes in this category.
label.acvcape.inventory_private: %s does not allow viewing their cape inventory.
label.acvcape.inventory_server: This server does not have Acv Cape installed, so the inventory of %s is unavailable.
label.acvcape.locked: The owner does not allow this cape to be used.
label.acvcape.others_empty: No capes from other players yet. Capes you download on servers appear here.
privacy.acvcape.inventory: Don't allow access to my inventory
privacy.acvcape.inventory.desc: Other players can't open your cape inventory by right-clicking you.
privacy.acvcape.use: Don't allow others to use my cape
privacy.acvcape.use.desc: Others can download and see it, but can't use it. It is deleted from their game when they leave the server.
privacy.acvcape.invisible.desc: You use the mod normally, but to other players it is as if you didn't have it.
tool.acvcape.bucket.desc: Marks the whole connected area of the same color (B)
tool.acvcape.color.desc: Marks every pixel of the same color in the whole texture (C)
tool.acvcape.brush.desc: Size of the pencil and the eraser
tooltip.acvcape.animation_speed: Animation speed of animated custom capes.
tooltip.acvcape.menu_scale: Size of the Acv Cape menus. 100% is the default size. Applied when you release the slider.
tooltip.acvcape.bucket_sensitivity: Paint bucket sensitivity. 0 only takes the exact color; higher values also take similar shades.
tooltip.acvcape.color_sensitivity: Color tool sensitivity. 0 only takes the exact color; higher values also take similar shades.
tooltip.acvcape.no_elytra_texture: This cape does not contain an elytra texture, the side effect is flying without anything on your back
tooltip.acvcape.download_policy: Sets what to do when finding other players' capes: Always downloads automatically, Never does not download and Ask shows a prompt before downloading.
acvcape.prompt.download_heavy: This cape is very heavy, are you sure you want to download this cape?
label.acvcape.emissive_empty: No emissive capes. Add emissivity to a Java, Bedrock or Dungeons II cape.
label.acvcape.default_cleared: Default restored to the account cape.
tool.acvcape.grid.desc: Shows the pixel grid from 12.00x zoom
